kebab_example: aliyun actiontrail describe-trail-delivery-metric-data --metric-name delivery_sls_success_count --trail-name trail-name --start-time 2026-04-09T01:00:00Z --end-time 2026-04-10T01:00:00Z --period 3600 --api-version 2020-07-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeTrailDeliveryMetricData

parameters.help_en:
The monitoring metrics name. Valid values:
delivery_sls_success_count: the number of logs successfully delivered to Simple Log Service (SLS).
delivery_sls_fail_count: the number of logs that failed to be delivered to SLS.
delivery_oss_success_count: the number of logs successfully delivered to Object Storage Service (OSS).
delivery_oss_fail_count: the number of logs that failed to be delivered to OSS
parameters.help_zh:
监控指标名称：
delivery_sls_success_count：投递SLS成功日志数量
delivery_sls_fail_count：投递SLS失败日志数量
delivery_oss_success_count：投递OSS成功日志数量
delivery_oss_fail_count：投递OSS失败日志数量
parameters.name: metric_name

parameters.help_en: The end time. The format is the same as StartTime
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The statistical period of the monitoring data. The minimum value is 60. Multiples of 60 are supported.

Recommended values: 60, 900, and 3600. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh:
监控数据的统计周期。最小值60，支持60的倍数。

推荐取值：60、900 和 3600。单位：秒
parameters.name: period

Count.description_en:
The count of the monitoring metrics. The specific meaning is determined by the MetricName request parameter.

For example, if MetricName is set to `delivery_sls_success_count`, the `Count` in the response represents the number of logs successfully delivered to SLS
Count.description_zh:
监控指标数量。具体含义由入参MetricName决定。

例如：MetricName入参为`delivery_sls_success_count`时，返回中的`Count`代表投递SLS成功日志数量

Timestamp.description_en: The time window corresponding to Count. This is the timestamp of the metric data point, expressed as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
Timestamp.description_zh: Count对应的时间窗口，指标数据点的时间，使用 Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒
